description: What fits one vehicle. Without a category: how many products fit, by category, and the category handles to ask with. With a category: up to eight products, each with its fit for this vehicle, its price for this vehicle and its page; carriers that mount to crossbars or a hitch come back with what they mount to and the base racks for the vehicle.

make.description: Make handle or name, e.g. toyota (find_vehicle gives it)

model.description: Model handle or name, e.g. corolla

roof_type.description: e.g. Naked Roof, Raised Rails, Flush Rails, Fixed Point, Tracks, Gutter

name: what_fits
title: What fits
